reason: Named independent lab with the batch report behind the QR code is what I normally have to hunt for, and the pre-counted sachets suit my travel weeks. At $24.99 for a first box I will try one and read the report before I open it.
objection: Brand new with no reviews yet, and made in China. I will check that the lab and the report are real and that the batch number matches. Two capsules a day is also a bit annoying.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report did not exist, or the batch number on the box did not match it, I would not buy.
